analysis.title: Editorial Portfolio in Forest Green
analysis.notes: The design combines forest green, cream, orange, yellow, and black with oversized serif typography, outlined lettering, cropped photography, and overlapping content blocks. Its portfolio structure uses strong section transitions, playful badges, decorative starbursts, and a dense editorial resume layout.
analysis.heroPrompt: Editorial portfolio hero composition featuring a softly blurred side-profile portrait of a young creative professional with dark hair, cropped inside a burnt-orange rectangular panel against a deep forest-green background. Add oversized cream high-contrast serif lettering partially overlapping the portrait, thin outlined decorative letterforms, small golden starburst accents, and a bold black lower band. Warm analog texture, sophisticated art-direction, sharp geometric blocks, asymmetrical layout, no logos, no readable text.
